newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EA-Generali calls news conference on CA.
newsitem.headline: EA-Generali calls news conference on CA.

text.p: Insurer EA-Generali, which heads an international consortium of bidders for Austrian selloff candidate Creditanstalt, has called a news conference for 18.30 local (1730 GMT) on Wednesday, a Generali spokesman said.

Leaders of the group met on Wednesday afternoon to discuss improvements in their existing offer for the government's 70 percent voting stake in Creditanstalt ahead of a final Friday deadline imposed by Finance Minister Viktor Klima.

The consortium has so far offered 13.8 billion schillings for the state's 19.9 million shares in the bank and wants to sell about a quarter of those on the market. The bid is three billion schillings short of a competing offer by Bank Austria. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
